title: xDrip Does not send local broadcast
body:
Hello all,
After the latest update for some reason, the app stopped sending local broadcasts.
I'm following the logs (Recent Errors/Warnings) and there is no mention of broadcast sent even though the local broadcast setting is enabled.
I also tried to  update to the latest nightly build and still nothing .
I'm using Android 8.0.0 on Samsung Galaxy A5(2017).
Does Anyone have a clue why it's happening?
Thanks in advance!
Here is ScreenShot of the settings
![screenshot_20181101-174818_xdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19548879/47862723-776f1380-ddfe-11e8-90d7-5d3e2943c261.jpg)

comments.body:
I see this same problem from time to time, it works for some hours then it stops working without any notification. Has set up a workaround in AndroidAPS to fill the gaps with data from NS, as xDrip uploads data to NS without any problem.
But doing this makes the loop rely on internet access and the NS database.

@Moshikol You say "After the latest update".

Would you please identify the last xDrip release that worked?

Sorry if I haven't closed the report. All is working fine presently.

I also found same issue where it says the xDrip+ is sending broadcast data but my customized apps that were supposed to read the BG broadcast from xDrip+ couldn't find the broadcast. I tested with fake data and I confirmed my apps can already listen to the broadcast from action : "com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip.BgEstimate" correctly so I have no idea why it seems like the broadcast is not going through.
